additional_replay_required.variant_e_hypothesis: Reduce overblocking while preserving non-zero volatility-skip direct block utility.

approval_gates: Run broader multi-period replay dataset before any runtime/default config change.
Compute Batch 4B evaluator metrics on every additional window.
Conflict rate must remain 0.0% or every conflict must be explicitly reviewed.
Directional coverage must improve without eliminating all risk guard utility across windows.
Julius must explicitly approve any runtime/default config change.
Rollback plan must be documented and tested before implementation.
No live execution mapping from StrategySignal to orders may be introduced.

variant-b.description: Moderate relaxation stress test: materially higher volatile confidence and ATR floors, with breakout allowed in volatile replay only.

variant-d.description: Trend-following confidence floor review: lower replay-only trend/action floors without changing production defaults.

recommendation.next_batch: Batch 3J - Broader Replay Validation for Volatility-Skip Calibration
recommendation.summary: Do not authorize production calibration yet. Use Variant D as the primary candidate for broader replay validation and Variant B as an aggressive upper-bound stress test only.

risk_assessment.evidence: Both promising variants reduce volatility_skip_direct_block_rate from 57.1% to 0.0% in the Batch 3G sample.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Require broader multi-period replay and consider an intermediate Variant E before runtime adoption.
risk_assessment.risk: Full suppression of volatility-skip direct blocks may be too aggressive.

risk_assessment.evidence: Batch 3H uses the Batch 3G replay window only.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Validate on at least 3-5 additional windows spanning trend_up, trend_down, volatile, and ranging regimes.
risk_assessment.risk: Single replay window may overfit one market period.

risk_assessment.evidence: Variant B has the best directional coverage but explicitly allows breakout in volatile replay context.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Treat Variant B as an aggressive stress-test candidate, not the first production candidate.
risk_assessment.risk: Variant B weakens risk posture by allowing volatile breakout in replay.

risk_assessment.evidence: Directional coverage improves from 10.0% to 10.7%, a +0.7 percentage-point move.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Use Variant D as primary validation candidate, not immediate production change.

risk_assessment.evidence: Batch 3H and 3I remain evaluation/proposal only and intentionally avoid PnL/backtest metrics.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Do not infer profitability; evaluate only strategy-vs-TraderAgent attribution quality.
risk_assessment.risk: No PnL/equity evidence exists by design.

steps: Revert strategy config to current defaults.
Disable any future calibration config block.
Re-run the Batch 4B evaluator against post-rollback replay artifacts.
Confirm baseline-like volatility guard behavior returns.
Keep StrategySignal observational-only unless separately approved.
trigger_conditions: Conflict rate rises materially in broader replay.
Volatility guard stops providing useful skip coverage across volatile windows.
Runtime behavior diverges from approved observational-only scope.

scope_boundary: Proposal only. No runtime behavior, production defaults, live trading, execution mapping, PnL/backtest, or order-routing changes are authorized.
